text.p: FirstService Corp said on Wednesday it acquired Philadelphia-based property manager Wentworth Group Inc for an undisclosed price.

The Toronto-based company said the acquisition makes it the largest full-service community association manager in the United States. FirstService's operations include property management, security services, landscaping and commercial cleaning.
In a separate transaction, Wentworth acquired competitor Barlow & Associates.

Wentworth and Barlow together serve more than 250 condominium and homeowner assocations with more than 45,000 units. During their last fiscal years the two companies generated aggregate revenues of US$7.0 million.

"FirstService now manages in excess of 1,000 condominium and homeowner associations representing more than 132,000 individual residential units in Florida, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York and Delaware," Jay Hennick, FirstService Corp chief executive, said in a statement.
Hennick said Wentworth's management team, including President Richard Oller and Chief Financial Officer David Epstein, would retain an significant interest in the company.
FirstService shares last traded on Monday at 8.95 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
